tests.title: Case 1 - Verify preset primary field is labeled 'Code' instead of 'Name' on preset definition tab
Case 2 - Verify preset code is mandatory and triggers 'Mandatory fields must be filled.' when empty on save
Case 3 - Verify preset code must be unique amongst other preset codes
Case 4 - Verify allowed characters in preset code (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, asterisks) are accepted
Case 5 - Verify invalid characters in preset code trigger specific validation error message
Case 6 - Verify error highlighting on Code field and preset tab is cleared after fixing issues
Case 7 - Verify monomer codes auto-update when preset code changes for auto-generated monomer codes
Case 8 - Verify manually changed monomer code is not auto-updated when preset code changes
Case 9 - Verify multiple sequential changes of preset code keep auto-update logic consistent
Case 10 - Verify existing presets with valid codes still save successfully after introducing new validation rules
Case 11 - Verify IDT and AxoLabs aliases for presets follow same uniqueness and validation rules as for monomers
